INSERT INTO ht_checkins (cin_no, cin_book_id, cin_cust_id, cin_room_id, cin_checkin_time, cin_expected_checkout, cin_adults, cin_children, cin_status, cin_rate_per_night, cin_notes)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, COALESCE($5, (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok')::timestamp), $6, $7, $8, 'active', $9::float8, $10)
        RETURNING cin_id
